$comment: Single source of truth for per-route metadata. Consumed at runtime by src/config/routeMeta.ts (pages call usePageMeta) and at build time by scripts/prerender.mjs, which writes one static HTML file per route and regenerates sitemap.xml. A route may set "output" to control the file it is written to (the 404 view needs 404.html, not 404/index.html). Keep the policy paths in sync with src/lib/policyPages.ts. Language editions set "lang" and "alternateOf" (the English path they translate); the prerender gives them <html lang>, hreflang links to every edition, and drops the English-only FAQPage structured data.
